info.title: PSM Partner Open API
info.description:
Partner APIs for provider companies.

**Getting started**
1. Log in as a provider user and generate an API key (`psm_pk_...`).
2. Ensure the company has **Open API Access** enabled by an administrator.
3. Send the API key on each request using `Authorization: Bearer {api_key}` (preferred) or `X-API-KEY: {api_key}`.

**Authentication**
Product and chat endpoints use the same provider API key. Send `Authorization: Bearer {api_key}` or `X-API-KEY: {api_key}`.

A legacy key, and a key whose scopes include `products`, can call both. A key whose scopes are only `chat` can call the chat endpoints and cannot call the product endpoints.
Generating a key revokes the previous active key for that user. Include every scope the new key should keep.

Product results and chat conversations are limited to the provider company linked to the API key.

post.description:
Creates a PSM chat message in a company-to-company conversation, or returns the existing message when the same external id is retried.

The API key identifies the sending company. That company must be a participant in the conversation. The sender user is the company's default contact, who must belong to that company and must not be blocked. The request cannot name a different sending company.

`external_conversation_id` is stored as a company-scoped mapping. The first request for an external conversation must include `psm_conversation_id`. Later requests may omit it. There is no matching by company name, contact name, or email.

Retries with the same `external_system` and `external_message_id` for the same conversation and body return HTTP 200 and do not create another message, broadcast, or notification. A reused external message id with a different body or conversation returns HTTP 409.

`external_created_at` is stored for reference. Unread counts use the PSM `created_at` of the chat message.

Rate limit: 60 requests per minute for the authenticated company.

201.description: Message created. Existing chat broadcast and notification behavior runs for this new message.

200.description: Idempotent retry. The original PSM message id is returned and no duplicate message is created.

401.description: Missing or invalid API key. A revoked key is treated as invalid.

403.description: Expired key, Open API disabled, non-provider account, API key not authorized for the partner APIs, or the conversation belongs to other companies.

404.description: PSM conversation was not found, or the external conversation has not been mapped yet.

409.description: The external message id was already used for a different body or conversation, or the external conversation id is mapped to a different PSM conversation.

422.description: Invalid fields, or the authenticated company has no valid default contact to use as the sender.

429.description: Too many requests (rate limit: 60 requests per minute per company).

get.description:
Returns conversations that include the authenticated company, so an integrator can choose `psm_conversation_id` for the first message mapping.

The payload is limited to the conversation id, counterparty company id and name, rental job id, and updated time. Message history is not included; use `GET /api/v1/partner/chat/conversations/{conversation}` for one conversation and its messages. Conversations that do not include the authenticated company are omitted.

Uses the same provider API key as the other partner public APIs. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute for the authenticated company.

403.description: Open API disabled, expired key, invalid provider context, or an API key that is not authorized for the partner APIs.

429.description: Too many requests (rate limit: 60 requests per minute per company).

get.summary: Get one conversation and its messages
get.description:
Returns one conversation that includes the authenticated company, together with that conversation's messages.

Messages are newest first and paginated with `page` and `per_page`. A deleted message is included with an empty body and `is_deleted: true`. `external_system`, `external_message_id`, and `external_conversation_id` are present only when this company stored that link; another company's external ids are omitted.

An unknown id returns 404. A conversation that does not include the authenticated company returns 403. Uses the same provider API key as the other partner public APIs. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute for the authenticated company.

parameters.name: conversation
parameters.description: PSM conversation id from the conversations list.

403.description: Open API disabled, expired key, invalid provider context, API key not authorized for the partner APIs, or the conversation belongs to other companies.

429.description: Too many requests (rate limit: 60 requests per minute per company).

get.description: Search products in the authenticated provider company inventory.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keyword (minimum 2 characters). Matches model, brand, category, and sub-category.

403.description: Open API access disabled, expired key, or invalid provider context.

422.description: Validation error (e.g. missing or short search query).

429.description: Too many requests (rate limit: 60 requests per minute).

get.description: List all products (minimal fields) for the authenticated provider company inventory.

403.description: Open API access disabled, expired key, or invalid provider context.

429.description: Too many requests (rate limit: 60 requests per minute).

get.description: Get full details for a single product in the provider company inventory.

403.description: Open API access disabled, expired key, or invalid provider context.

404.description: Product not found in provider inventory.

429.description: Too many requests (rate limit: 60 requests per minute).

external_system.description: Stable system slug. Allowed values: rentman, flex.

psm_conversation_id.description: Required until this external conversation id is mapped. Must be a conversation the authenticated company belongs to.

body.example: Hello, we have received your rental request.

external_created_at.description: Stored on the external message link. Unread state uses the PSM message timestamp.

partnerApiKey.description: Provider API key. Format: `psm_pk_...`. Product and chat routes accept this same key: legacy keys and keys that include the `products` scope. Chat also accepts a key that includes only the `chat` scope. Alternative header: `X-API-KEY`.
